standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
standards.description: Foundational Indian standard for plain and reinforced concrete structural design.

standards.title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces - Code of Practice
standards.description: Mandatory seismic ductile detailing code for RCC beams, columns, and joints in seismic zones.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures - Part 1: Dead Loads - Unit Weights of Building Materials and Stored Materials
standards.description: Unit weights of building materials, partition loads, and stored material loads for dead load computation.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures - Part 2: Imposed Loads
standards.description: Codified floor, roof, and occupancy live loads for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures - Part 3: Wind Loads
standards.description: Basic wind speed map, risk coefficient k1, terrain factor k2, topography factor k3, and design wind pressure pz.

standards.title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures - Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
standards.description: Seismic zone factors (Z), importance factors (I), response reduction factors (R), and base shear.

standards.title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice
standards.description: Limit state design of structural steel tension, compression, and flexural members and connections.

handbooks.title: Design Aids for Reinforced Concrete to IS 456:1978
handbooks.description: Design charts and tables for flexural moments, shear, and column P-M interaction.

handbooks.title: Handbook on Concrete Reinforcement and Detailing
handbooks.description: Standard detailing conventions, bar bending schedules, hook lengths, and drafting rules.

handbooks.title: Explanatory Handbook on Indian Standard Code of Practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete (IS 456:1978)
handbooks.description: Theoretical derivations, historical commentary, and clause-by-clause explanatory notes.
